title: Veterans Pension Care-Cost Adjustments — The Monthly Care Figure
content:
In a Veterans Pension care-cost rate adjustment, the monthly care figure follows the care months reported — the medical expense reports received on the award in the 3 whole months before the adjustment, each report one care month. The most recent month is the report with the latest expense period start; the average is the total of those reports divided by their number.

- **At least 3 care months reported, most recent month above the average:** the most recent month is the monthly figure.
- **At least 3 care months reported, most recent month at or below the average:** the average, rounded to the cent, is the monthly figure.
- **Otherwise** (fewer than 3 care months reported): the total reported stands in its place.

## Worked cases (hypothetical care months)

| Care months reported | Average | Most recent | Monthly care figure |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1200.00, 1300.00, 1700.00 (most recent 1700.00) | 1400.00 | above | 1700.00 |
| 1500.00, 1500.00, 1500.00 | 1500.00 | equal — at the average | 1500.00 |
| 1800.00, 1400.00, 1000.00 (most recent 1000.00) | 1400.00 | below | 1400.00 |
| 1000.00, 1000.00, 1001.00 (most recent 1000.00) | 1000.33 | below | 1000.33 |
| 1200.00, 1300.00 | — | fewer than 3 | 2500.00 (the total) |
